class Mentor:
    def __init__(self):
        self._cachedHashCode = None
        self._canSetMain = True
        self._canSetSecondaries = True
        self._main = None
        self._secondaries = []

    def getMain(self):
        return self._main

    def hasMain(self):
        return self._main is not None

    def getSecondary(self, index):
        return self._secondaries[index]

    def getSecondaries(self):
        return tuple(self._secondaries)

    def numberOfSecondaries(self):
        return len(self._secondaries)

    def hasSecondaries(self):
        return len(self._secondaries) > 0

    def indexOfSecondary(self, aSecondary):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._secondaries) if x is aSecondary), -1)

    def setMain(self, aNewMain):
        if not self._canSetMain:
            return False
        if aNewMain is None:
            existingMain = self._main
            self._main = None
            if existingMain is not None and existingMain.getMentorMain() is not None:
                existingMain.setMentorMain(None)
            return True
        currentMain = self._main
        if currentMain is not None and currentMain is not aNewMain:
            currentMain.setMentorMain(None)
        self._main = aNewMain
        existingMentorMain = aNewMain.getMentorMain()
        if existingMentorMain is not self:
            aNewMain.setMentorMain(self)
        return True

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfSecondaries():
        return 0

    def addSecondary(self, aSecondary):
        if not self._canSetSecondaries:
            return False
        if any(x is aSecondary for x in self._secondaries):
            return False
        existingMentorSecondary = aSecondary.getMentorSecondary()
        if existingMentorSecondary is None:
            if not aSecondary.setMentorSecondary(self):
                return False
        elif existingMentorSecondary is not self:
            if not existingMentorSecondary.removeSecondary(aSecondary):
                return False
            if not self.addSecondary(aSecondary):
                return False
        else:
            self._secondaries.append(aSecondary)
        return True

    def removeSecondary(self, aSecondary):
        if not self._canSetSecondaries:
            return False
        index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._secondaries) if x is aSecondary), -1)
        if index < 0:
            return False
        del self._secondaries[index]
        if not aSecondary.setMentorSecondary(None):
            self._secondaries.insert(index, aSecondary)
            return False
        return True

    def addSecondaryAt(self, aSecondary, index):
        if not self.addSecondary(aSecondary):
            return False
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfSecondaries():
            index = self.numberOfSecondaries() - 1
        del self._secondaries[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._secondaries) if x is aSecondary), -1)]
        self._secondaries.insert(index, aSecondary)
        return True

    def addOrMoveSecondaryAt(self, aSecondary, index):
        if not self._canSetSecondaries:
            return False
        if not any(x is aSecondary for x in self._secondaries):
            return self.addSecondaryAt(aSecondary, index)
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfSecondaries():
            index = self.numberOfSecondaries() - 1
        del self._secondaries[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._secondaries) if x is aSecondary), -1)]
        self._secondaries.insert(index, aSecondary)
        return True

    def __eq__(self, obj):
        if type(obj) is not type(self):
            return NotImplemented
        return (self.getMain(), self.getSecondaries()) == (obj.getMain(), obj.getSecondaries())

    def __hash__(self):
        if self._cachedHashCode is None:
            self._cachedHashCode = hash((self.getMain(), self.getSecondaries()))
            self._canSetMain = False
            self._canSetSecondaries = False
        return self._cachedHashCode

    def equals(self, obj):
        return self == obj

    def delete(self):
        if self._main is not None:
            self._main.setMentorMain(None)
        for aSecondary in tuple(self._secondaries):
            aSecondary.setMentorSecondary(None)
